identity.title: [v0.91.8][runtime][api] Reconcile CSM runtime advertised endpoints with mounted routes

review_prompts: Check that advertised availability and mounted routes agree.
Check that Runtime v3 kernel readiness is not confused with CSM runtime API readiness.
Check that tests fail on future inventory/router drift.
residual_risk: The exact-head review did not rerun Cargo tests; it reviewed source and retained typed finalize evidence.
The two Cargo validation logs may include local build paths, so their PVF evidence policy intentionally does not claim relative-only log content.
